option_relations.rationale: Metastatic papillary thyroid carcinoma is a specific type of thyroid cancer that can metastasize to bone, making the leaf a supertype of this option.
Metastatic follicular thyroid carcinoma is a specific type of thyroid cancer that can metastasize to bone, making the leaf a supertype of this option.
Metastatic thyroid carcinoma is a broader category that includes thyroid metastasis to bone, making the leaf a supertype of this option.
Follicular thyroid carcinoma with manubrial invasion describes a specific type of thyroid cancer with bone involvement, making the leaf a supertype of this option.
